## What changed

Describe the focused technical outcome.

## Why

Explain the problem, threat, governance invariant, or reviewer need addressed.

## Verification

- [ ] Existing tests pass
- [ ] New/changed behavior has a reproducible check
- [ ] Security or governance assumptions are stated
- [ ] Documentation is updated when semantics change

## Evidence

Include commands, screenshots, test output, or reviewer steps as appropriate.

## Collaboration credit

If this change was genuinely co-developed, include the appropriate `Co-authored-by:` trailers in the relevant commits.
